mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Verona Area High School with a temperature of 81 degrees, though it feels a bit warmer at 88 degrees.

A few updates from City Hall: all city facilities will be closed this Monday for Labor Day, and the Senior Center is undergoing a flooring project that will result in various programming changes and closures through September 11.

We have a busy start to the week with Hop Haus Trivia and Quizmasters Trivia at Lake Lou-ee both happening today. Tomorrow, you can look forward to the Downtown Farmer's Market and a variety of evening trivia and live music events.
Looking at the weekly report, on August 30, an officer witnessed a vehicle versus bicyclist crash at East Verona Avenue and Lincoln Street, resulting in a citation for the driver.
It is a great day to stop by Culver's for the Chocolate Heath Crunch, which is today's flavor of the day. The restaurant is currently open and will remain so until their 10 PM closing time.
